preview_heading: Kings meet Falcons in Gros Islet
preview: Saint Lucia Kings face Antigua & Barbuda Falcons in CPL 2026 Match 7 at Daren Sammy Cricket Ground. The match is scheduled for Fri 14 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
